html:
This full day Island Life Trip by speedboat offers a deeper look into the authentic lifestyle of Phu Quoc Island. The tour is designed for small groups, allowing guests to enjoy a relaxed pace, hands-on activities, and close interaction with nature.

Accompanied by an experienced local guide, guests will travel by modern speedboat, experience traditional handline fishing, explore unspoiled snorkeling areas, and enjoy a barbecue lunch prepared on the island.

ITINERARY

Morning Program

09:00
Pick up at the hotel in Duong Dong Ward or at Vietlook Travel office.
Guests staying outside Duong Dong Ward are requested to contact Vietlook Travel in advance.

Depart from Vietlook Travel office and transfer to An Thoi Harbor.

09:30
Arrive at An Thoi Harbor and board the speedboat.

During the boat ride, guests enjoy views of the southern islands and Phu Quoc’s natural coastline.

10:00
Fishing experience begins. Guests try traditional handline fishing with assistance from the crew. All fishing equipment is provided.

Midday Program

11:00
Snorkeling activity at an unspoiled snorkeling spot. Guests explore coral reefs and observe colorful marine life in clear water.

12:30
Arrive at the island. Guests relax on the beach while the crew prepares lunch.

13:00
Island life lunch. Guests enjoy a private barbecue meal and free beer during lunchtime.

Afternoon Program

15:30
Free time on the island for swimming, snorkeling, strolling along the coastline, sunbathing, or relaxing on hammocks.

16:00
Return to An Thoi Harbor by speedboat.

16:30
Transfer back to the hotel. Tour ends.

TOUR PRICE

Adults aged ten years and above:
Sixty United States dollars per guest.

Children from five to nine years old:
Thirty United States dollars per guest.

Children under five years old:
Free of charge.

TOUR INCLUDES

Round-trip transportation by car and speedboat.

English-speaking tour guide.

Island life barbecue lunch.

Drinking water and fresh fruit.

Snorkeling equipment including mask, snorkel, and fins.
Fins are not available in children’s sizes.

Life jackets.

Local fishing equipment.

Free use of sun loungers, hammocks, and fresh water showers on the island.

TOUR EXCLUDES

Personal expenses.

IMPORTANT NOTES

In case of unfavorable weather conditions, the captain may change the island destination according to actual sea conditions.

Please bring towels, swimwear, spare clothes, sunscreen, comfortable shoes or flip-flops, and some cash.

Seafood caught by the crew, such as fish, snails, or crabs, will be boiled and served to guests at no additional charge.

LUNCH MENU

Barbecue fish slices.

Barbecue squid.

Barbecue shrimp.

Grilled sea urchin with green onion.

Seafood hotpot with shrimp, fish, and squid.

Fresh salad.

Grilled sweet potatoes, corn, and okra.

Steamed rice.

Fresh fruit including watermelon, pineapple, and mango.

Free beer during lunchtime.

Special meal requests such as vegan, vegetarian, or children’s meals must be informed at the time of booking or at least twenty-four hours before departure.

CHILDREN’S PRICING POLICY

Children under five years old:
Free of charge.

Children from five to nine years old:
Charged at fifty percent of the adult price.

Children aged ten years and above:
Charged at the adult price.

Age is based on year of birth.

PAYMENT POLICY

Groups of one to five guests

A deposit of fifty percent is required upon booking.

The remaining balance must be settled no later than one day before the tour date or on the tour day.

Groups of six guests or more

A deposit of fifty percent is required upon booking.

The remaining balance must be settled no later than one day before the tour date.

CANCELLATION POLICY

Groups of one to five guests

Cancellation one day before the tour date:
No cancellation fee will be charged.

Cancellation on the tour date:
One hundred percent of the total tour value will be charged as a cancellation fee.

Groups of six guests or more

Cancellation two days before the tour date:
No cancellation fee will be charged.

Cancellation one day before the tour date:
Fifty percent of the total tour value will be charged as a cancellation fee.

Cancellation on the tour date:
One hundred percent of the total tour value will be charged as a cancellation fee.

Weather-related cancellations

If the Port Authority does not allow the tour to depart, Vietlook Travel will cancel the tour and provide a full refund.

If the Port Authority allows the tour to operate but guests choose to cancel, no refund will be provided.

TIPS AND RESPONSIBILITY

Guests are requested to bring towels, eco-friendly sunscreen, swimwear, spare clothes, and personal necessities.

Do not throw trash into the sea or leave trash on the island. Please use provided trash and recycling bins.

When snorkeling, guests must not touch or damage coral reefs. Life jackets must be worn at all times. Adults must supervise children. Non-swimmers should follow the tour guide’s instructions closely.

Vietlook Travel and team members are not responsible for lost, misplaced, or stolen items.

HEALTH AND SAFETY

This tour is not recommended for guests with limited mobility, wheelchair users, or guests with serious medical conditions such as asthma, heart problems, seizures, or epilepsy.

Pregnant women and elderly guests should consult a doctor before joining the tour.

Vietlook Travel is not responsible for any health-related issues during or after the tour.
